data.description:
Property Management Expert Amy Reynolds Explains Rental Income Strategies in HelloNation

Property Management Expert Amy Reynolds Explains Rental Income Strategies in HelloNation

PR Newswire

FAYETTEVILLE, N.C., Oct. 16, 2026

The Article Explains How Investors Can Evaluate Rental Income, Property Expenses, and Potential Profits Before Purchasing an Investment Property.

FAYETTEVILLE, N.C., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- What should investors evaluate before purchasing an investment property? HelloNation has published an article that answers this question with insights from Amy Reynolds of ACE Real Estate & Property Management in Fayetteville, NC.

The article explains that estimating rental income accurately is one of the most important parts of evaluating an investment property. While a property may initially appear profitable, long-term rental profits often depend on local market conditions, vacancy trends, and total ownership costs. The article notes that careful financial planning can help investors avoid unrealistic expectations before deciding to buy.

According to the HelloNation article, one of the first steps in evaluating rental income is to compare similar rental homes in the same market. Investors are encouraged to review properties with similar layouts, square footage, condition, and neighborhood characteristics. Recently leased rental homes may offer a clearer picture of actual market demand than active listings alone. In Fayetteville, NC, rental prices may vary based on factors such as access to schools, local employers, and proximity to Fort Liberty.

The article also emphasizes the importance of studying vacancy trends before purchasing an investment property. Even homes with strong monthly rental income projections can become less profitable if vacancies occur frequently. Investors are encouraged to account for potential vacancy periods in their calculations rather than assuming continuous occupancy year-round. The article explains that conservative vacancy estimates often provide a more realistic view of annual cash flow.

Ownership expenses are another major focus. The HelloNation article explains that mortgage payments represent only part of the ongoing financial responsibilities associated with an investment property. Property taxes, insurance costs, maintenance, landscaping, repairs, and property management fees should all be included when calculating expected rental property profits. Older rental homes may require additional reserve funds due to aging systems or deferred maintenance.

The article also explains that newer investors commonly underestimate maintenance costs. Routine maintenance, appliance replacements, HVAC servicing, and tenant turnover expenses can gradually reduce rental income. Some property owners also maintain reserve funds for emergency repairs to reduce financial strain when unexpected issues arise. The article notes that accounting for these ownership expenses early may help investors better understand long-term profitability expectations.

Property management services are also discussed as part of a balanced investment strategy. The article explains that professional property management may include lease administration, tenant screening, maintenance coordination, rent collection, inspections, and communication support. Although these services reduce immediate monthly rental income, many investors view property management as valuable for supporting stable operations and reducing vacancy trends. The article notes that consistent oversight may also help preserve property condition and tenant retention.

For those evaluating opportunities in Fayetteville, NC, the article explains that rental income potential depends on several local market factors. Single-family rental homes near military housing demand may experience more stable interest rates, while other neighborhoods may show different pricing patterns. Property size, amenities, local supply levels, and condition all contribute to expected rental property profits.

The article also encourages investors to avoid relying solely on best-case projections. Inflated rental income estimates or underestimated ownership expenses can create financial challenges later. Instead, conservative financial analysis can help determine whether an investment property remains sustainable during slower market periods or when maintenance costs increase unexpectedly.

The article concludes that careful preparation before purchasing an investment property may help investors make more informed financial decisions. By reviewing comparable rental homes, studying vacancy trends, and fully accounting for ownership expenses, investors may better understand long-term rental property profits in Fayetteville, NC.

How to Estimate Rental Income Before Purchasing an Investment Property features insights from Amy Reynolds, a Property Management Expert in Fayetteville, North Carolina, on HelloNation.

data.title: HelloNation Examines Repair vs Replace HVAC Decisions With Insights From HVAC Expert Leslie Roe
data.description:
HelloNation Examines Repair vs Replace HVAC Decisions With Insights From HVAC Expert Leslie Roe

HelloNation Examines Repair vs Replace HVAC Decisions With Insights From HVAC Expert Leslie Roe

PR Newswire

TRAVERSE CITY, Mich., Nov. 20, 2026

The article outlines key factors that influence cost, efficiency, and long-term home comfort.

TRAVERSE CITY, Mich., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- What should homeowners consider first when deciding between repair vs replace HVAC systems? The answer is explored in a HelloNation article that offers guidance and features insights from HVAC Expert Leslie Roe of Precision Plumbing and Heating Systems in Traverse City, Michigan.

The HelloNation article explains that HVAC system age is one of the most important factors in the repair-versus-replace decision. Systems typically last 10 to 15 years, and as HVAC systems age, the likelihood of costly breakdowns increases. The article notes that when a unit nears the end of its expected lifespan, replacement may offer more value than repeated furnace repair or temporary fixes.

Maintenance history also plays a central role in evaluating repair vs replace HVAC options. The article describes how a consistent maintenance history often leads to better performance and fewer disruptions. In contrast, poor maintenance history can lead to recurring HVAC issues that drive up repair costs over time. HVAC Expert Leslie Roe emphasizes in the article that recurring HVAC issues often signal that replacement should be considered more seriously.

The article also examines the type and severity of system problems. Minor issues, such as thermostat malfunctions or small leaks, may require only furnace repair or targeted service. However, multiple component failures and recurring HVAC issues often point to a system that can no longer operate efficiently. In these cases, the article explains that repair may provide only short-term relief, while AC replacement may offer a more stable long-term solution.

Energy use is another major factor discussed in the article. Older systems tend to lack modern heating and cooling efficiency, leading to higher monthly utility costs. The article highlights that upgrading to an AC replacement can significantly improve heating and cooling efficiency while reducing strain on the system. Improved heating and cooling efficiency not only lowers expenses but also enhances year-round home comfort.

Comfort and performance are closely tied to system condition. The article notes that uneven temperatures, weak airflow, and frequent cycling can reduce home comfort and signal deeper system problems. HVAC Expert Leslie Roe explains in the article that maintaining home comfort is often easier with newer systems designed for consistent performance. While furnace repair may temporarily restore function, long-term home comfort is often improved by replacement when systems are outdated.

Budget considerations are also addressed in the HelloNation article. Repair costs are usually lower at first, making furnace repair an appealing short-term option. However, the article explains that repeated repairs tied to recurring HVAC issues can quickly add up. AC replacement requires a higher upfront investment, but it can reduce future expenses and improve heating and cooling efficiency over time.

The article concludes that evaluating HVAC system age, maintenance history, repair frequency, and overall home comfort helps homeowners make informed decisions. By carefully weighing repair vs replace HVAC options, homeowners can better manage costs and system reliability. Consulting a qualified HVAC Expert is recommended to assess current performance and provide a clear path forward based on individual needs.

Should You Repair or Replace Your HVAC System? What Homeowners Should Consider First features insights from Leslie Roe, an HVAC expert at Precision Plumbing and Heating in Traverse City, Michigan, on HelloNation.

data.title: Ayrton Senna's style leads the Senna brand into fashion and lifestyle
data.description:
Ayrton Senna's style leads the Senna brand into fashion and lifestyle

Ayrton Senna's style leads the Senna brand into fashion and lifestyle

PR Newswire

SAO PAULO, Oct. 16, 2026

New collaborations connect fashion and motorsport to reach new audiences: five in 10 Americans who know the three-time Formula One world champion also see him as a fashion inspiration

SAO PAULO, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Senna, the brand that represents the values of three-time Formula One world champion Ayrton Senna, is expanding into fashion and lifestyle. This month it launched its first global collection with Zara, one of the world's largest fashion retailers. The collection is available at Zara.com and in 200 selected stores worldwide. The brand will also release custom sneakers with Chummy's Customs and new official collections at SennaShop.com, including a collaboration with Classic Team Lotus.

The move follows a shift in how people relate to Senna today. Five in 10 Americans who know Senna see him as a fashion inspiration, according to a survey conducted by Senna Brands in the United States. Many of them never saw him race.

"A lot of people meet Ayrton today through a TV series, a photograph, a jacket, and not on a racetrack," said Bianca Senna, global CEO of Senna Brands. "Fashion lets us meet them where they already are, with products that carry what he stood for: overcoming limits, excellence and constant evolution."

Ayrton Senna won 41 races and three world championships in Formula One, the top tier of international motor racing. Off the track, his style was simple and consistent: jeans, polo shirts, a leather jacket. The Zara collection draws on one of his best-known images, in which he wears jeans and '90s sunglasses, has a jacket over his shoulder and carries a briefcase, with a plane behind him.

The 17-piece collection includes a minimalist black leather jacket inspired by one he wore, a Prince of Wales check blazer, the polo shirts associated with his public image and racing jackets carrying the Senna logo.

Later this year, the brand will release a collaboration with Chummy's Customs, a studio that hand-customizes sneakers. The limited editions, of 500 pairs, carry references to Senna's career. At SennaShop.com, a new collection made in official partnership with Classic Team Lotus, the team Senna drove for in Formula One from 1985 to 1987, features design elements from its iconic cars.

Senna is present in more than 70 countries, and the new launches join a partner portfolio that includes TAG Heuer, McLaren, Ducati and recent launches with LEGO and Sea-Doo. In Brazil, the brand also works with Asics and New Era Cap. More collaborations will be announced in 2027, taking Ayrton Senna's name from the starting grid to the streets.

"Fashion is looking back at the '90s, and Formula One has a new generation of fans. Ayrton sits right where those two meet," said Bianca Senna. "He never dressed to make a statement, and that is exactly why his style still works."

About Senna brand
Senna is a global brand that connects the legacy and values of three-time Formula 1 World Champion Ayrton Senna to audiences around the world, inspiring generations to become the best version of themselves. Founded in 1990, the brand today spans more than 60 partners with a direct presence in over 70 countries through licensed products and strategic collaborations. Brand royalties help fund Instituto Ayrton Senna, supporting public education in Brazil for over 30 years.

data.title: AM Best Revises Outlooks to Positive, Affirms Credit Ratings of BTG Pactual Resseguradora S.A. and BTG Pactual Seguros S.A.
data.description:
AM Best Revises Outlooks to Positive, Affirms Credit Ratings of BTG Pactual Resseguradora S.A. and BTG Pactual Seguros S.A.

AM Best has revised the outlooks to positive from stable and affirmed the Financial Strength Rating of B++ (Good) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating of “bbb+” (Good) of BTG Pactual Resseguradora S.A. (BTG Re) (São Paulo, Brazil) and BTG Pactual Seguros S.A. (BTG Seguros) (São Paulo, Brazil). Concurrently, AM Best has affirmed the Brazil National Scale Rating (NSR) of “aaa.BR” (Exceptional) of BTG Re and BTG Seguros. The outlook of this NSR is stable.

The Credit Ratings (ratings) reflect BTG Re’s balance sheet strength, which AM Best assesses as very strong, as well as its adequate operating performance, neutral business profile and appropriate enterprise risk management.

The positive outlooks on these ratings reflect AM Best’s expectation that BTG Re will maintain its risk-adjusted capitalization at the strongest level, as measured by Best’s Capital Adequacy Ratio (BCAR), supported by the initiatives implemented by its management.

BTG Re is a domestic reinsurer in Brazil, operating predominantly in the surety segments in Brazil, Latin America, and recently, in Portugal and Spain, as part of its expansion strategy. The company also recently entered the agricultural line through business assumed from its affiliated company, TOO Seguros S.A. BTG Re’s intermediate parent, Banco BTG Pactual S.A. (BTG Pactual) [B3: BPAC11], provides operational support and risk management capabilities and can provide liquidity if needed.

Also reflected in BTG Re’s ratings is the impact of its credit profile and Brazil’s challenging and volatile macroeconomic and political environment, which continues to hamper meaningful economic recovery and stability in the country. BTG Pactual has shown a consistent trend in its results and credit strength while expanding and diversifying its operations; however, BTG Re’s ratings are somewhat limited by its domestic operating environment.

BTG Re maintains solid standalone attributes in terms of operating performance, including low loss and expense ratios, and the strongest level of risk-adjusted capitalization, as measured by BCAR. BTG Re has produced positive earnings since inception, driven by underwriting results and investment income. BTG Re also benefits from a solid retrocession program that mitigates its underwriting exposures; the company’s reinsurance retention remains low.

BTG Seguros is a domestic insurer in Brazil, operating predominantly in the country’s surety segment. The company takes advantage of the business profile and market presence of its affiliated company, BTG Re, to which it cedes almost all of its risk.

BTG Seguros maintains adequate standalone attributes in terms of operating performance, including low loss and expense ratios, and the strongest level of risk-adjusted capitalization, as measured by BCAR. BTG Seguros has produced positive earnings in recent years, mainly driven by investment income. AM Best’s analysis of BTG Seguros and BTG Re benefits from BTG Pactual’s expertise, stemming from its long track record with a portfolio of large companies.

AM Best continues to monitor BTG Seguros and BTG Re’s balance sheet strength, operating performance, risk-adjusted capitalization and the execution of its product and geographic expansion, along with the credit profile of its parent.

Positive rating actions could take place if the company sustains its balance sheet strength at the strongest level or better in the intermediate term. Negative rating actions could take place if a deterioration in its business profile occurs due to volatility in the country’s economy, which could affect the company’s performance.

This press release relates to Credit Ratings that have been published on AM Best’s website. For all rating information relating to the release and pertinent disclosures, including details of the office responsible for issuing each of the individual ratings referenced in this release, please see AM Best’s Recent Rating Activity web page. For additional information regarding the use and limitations of Credit Rating opinions, please view Guide to Best’s Credit Ratings. For information on the proper use of Best’s Credit Ratings, Best’s Performance Assessments, Best’s Preliminary Credit Assessments and AM Best press releases, please view Guide to Proper Use of Best’s Ratings & Assessments.

AM Best is a global credit rating agency, news publisher and data analytics provider specializing in the insurance industry. Headquartered in the United States, the company does business in over 100 countries with regional offices in London, Amsterdam, Dubai, Hong Kong, Singapore and Mexico City. data.title: Chino Commercial Bancorp Reports 22% Increase in Third Quarter Earnings
data.description:
CHINO, Calif., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Chino Commercial Bancorp (OTC: CCBC), the parent company of Chino Commercial Bank, N.A., announced the results of operations for the Bank and the consolidated holding company for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Net earnings for the third quarter of 2026 were $1.88 million, reflecting an increase of $338 thousand, or an increase of 22%, compared to the same period last year. Basic and diluted earnings per share were $0.49 for the third quarter of 2026, up from $0.40 for the same quarter in 2025. Net earnings increased year-to-date by $951 thousand, or 21%, to $5.39 million, as compared to $4.43 million for the same period last year. Year-to-date basic and diluted earnings per share were $1.40 for the period ending September 30, 2026, as compared with $1.15 or a 22% increase over the same period last year. Earnings per share for the prior year were adjusted for the 20 percent stock dividend, which was payable to shareholders of record as of June 18, 2026.

Dann H. Bowman, President and Chief Executive Officer, stated “We are pleased with the Bank’s performance year-to-date and during the third quarter of 2026, which set new records for total Assets, total Deposits, total Loans, Net Earnings, and Capital. In addition, Loan quality remains very strong, with the Bank having no delinquent loans at quarter-end.

Locally, we believe the economic engine of the Inland Empire is strong and diverse, and the Bank is well positioned to continue to help the small business customers in our market.”

Financial Condition

As of September 30, 2026, total assets were $543 million, being an increase of $49 million, or 10%, over $494 million on December 31, 2025. Total deposits rose by $43.2 million, or 11.7%, to $413.4 million, up from $370.2 million on December 31, 2025. Core deposits accounted for 97.5% of total deposits as of September 30, 2026.

Gross loans increased by $32.6 million, or 14.8%, totaling $253.2 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $220.6 million as of December 31, 2025. At the end of the third quarter, the Bank reported no delinquent loans and three nonaccrual loans totaling $1.2 million. As of September 30, 2026, the Bank had no Other Real Estate Owned (OREO) properties.

Earnings

The Company reported net interest income of $4.7 million for the three months ending September 30, 2026, compared to $4.0 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of $656.9 thousand. Average interest-earning assets were $443.2 million, while average interest-bearing liabilities totaled $234.4 million, resulting in a net interest margin of 4.20% for the third quarter of 2026. This compares favorably with the prior year’s third quarter margin of 3.78%, based on average interest-earning assets of $423.0 million and average interest-bearing liabilities of $223.3 million.

Non-interest income for the third quarter of 2026 was $924.9 thousand, which was an increase of 3.72% compared to $891.8 thousand for the same period last year. Much of the increase was from higher Merchant Service processing fees, which rose by $91 thousand or 44% to $297 thousand. These increases were partially offset by reductions in lower Service Charges and Fees of $87 thousand or 19%, due to lower overdraft and other deposit account related charges.

The Bank’s Merchant Services Program continues to be one of the Company's fastest-growing business lines. For the quarter ending September 30, 2026, card processing sales volume increased by $7.1 million or 40% to $24.9 million, compared with $17.8 million for the same quarter last year. On a year-to-date basis through September 30, 2026, card processing sales volume increased by $17.2 million or 39.1% to $61.0 million, as compared to $43.8 million for the same period last year.

General and administrative expenses totaled $2.8 million for the three months ending September 30, 2026, compared to $2.8 million for the same period in 2025. The largest part of these expenses was salary and benefits, which amounted to $1.8 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $1.6 million for the same period last year. The Company’s core efficiency ratio decreased to 50.02% for the third quarter of 2026 compared to 55.95% for the same period last year.

Income tax expense for the quarter was $726.3 thousand, reflecting an increase of $112.2 thousand, or 18.3%, compared to $614.1 thousand for the same period last year. The Company’s effective income tax rate was approximately 27.86% for the period ending September 30, 2026, and 28.48% for the same period last year.

Forward-Looking Statements

The statements contained in this press release that are not historical facts are forward-looking statements based on management’s current expectations and beliefs concerning future developments and their potential effects on the Company. Readers are cautioned, not to unduly rely on forward-looking statements. Actual results may differ from those projected. These forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties, including but not limited to, the health of the national and California economies, the Company’s ability to attract and retain skilled employees, customers’ service expectations, the Company’s ability to successfully deploy new technology and gain efficiencies therefrom, and changes in interest rates, loan portfolio performance, and other factors.

Chino Commercial Bank has five banking offices located in the Cities of - Chino, Ontario, Upland, Rancho Cucamonga, and Corona. Learn more at www.chinocommercialbank.com.

data.title: Mercedes-Benz USA Reports Quarterly Passenger Car Sales Growth of 4%
data.description:
Mercedes-Benz USA Reports Quarterly Passenger Car Sales Growth of 4%

  • Mercedes-Benz USA retailed 76,200 passenger cars in Q3 2026, representing a 4% increase over Q3 2025.
  • Third-quarter retail sales totaled 85,800 units (+3%), comprised of 76,200 passenger cars and 9,600 vans.
  • The Core segment delivered double-digit quarterly growth (+12%) and year-to-date gains (+5%), underpinned by outstanding demand for Mercedes-Benz SUVs.
  • Top-End vehicle sales remained strong, led by 47% S-Class growth and high demand across the Mercedes-Maybach model range.

Mercedes-Benz USA (MBUSA) today reported third-quarter passenger car sales of 76,200 vehicles, which represents a 4% increase for passenger car sales over Q3 2025. With 9,600 vans delivered throughout Q3, overall MBUSA retail sales for the quarter were up 3% with 85,800 units sold.

The quarterly growth and strong momentum was fueled by sustained demand across the Mercedes-Benz SUV lineup, the Core vehicle portfolio, and the Top-End vehicle range. The Alabama-built GLE delivered double-digit year-to-date growth, while the GLC remained one of the brand's highest-volume models with positive year-to-date gains. The E-Class and S-Class also delivered exceptional quarterly gains of 39% and 47%, respectively.

“Together with our fantastic dealer partners, we delivered positive growth and outperformed a challenging automotive market. Our gains reflect the strong appeal of our broad and versatile family of SUVs, the continued strength of our top-end vehicle range and the enduring power of the Mercedes-Benz brand. With a robust pipeline of new, highly compelling products arriving at U.S. dealerships including the new GLE and GLS SUVs and the new S-Class, we will further strengthen our U.S. vehicle portfolio to build on this momentum.”

Adam Chamberlain, President and CEO of Mercedes-Benz USA

Top-End:
Demand for the Mercedes-Benz Top-End vehicle portfolio remained strong in the third quarter, led by continued momentum from the S-Class which reported 47% growth in Q3. Mercedes-Maybach sales increased 21% year-to-date, highlighting continued customer desire for the brand's most exclusive models. The successful launch of the highly anticipated new S-Class Sedan marks the next chapter in its long history, reinforcing its position as the flagship luxury sedan setting the benchmark in the industry.

Core:
The Core segment remained strong, delivering growth both in the quarter (+12%) and year-to-date (+5%). The GLC and GLE remained key pillars of the Mercedes-Benz portfolio in the third quarter. The GLE, proudly built in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, delivered double-digit year-to-date growth, underscoring the unwavering customer demand for premium SUVs in the U.S. market.

Entry:
Entry vehicle retail sales were up 3% in the third quarter, with the GLA posting notable sales gains of 63% for Q3.

Vans:
Demand for premium commercial mobility solutions remained resilient, driving Mercedes-Benz Vans retail sales up 1% to 9,600 units in the third quarter. Supported by a comprehensive lineup that combines versatility, capability, and innovation, the Vans business continues to provide customers with tailored transportation solutions to meet a diverse range of operational and industry needs.

Mercedes-Benz Group:
Globally, Mercedes-Benz continued to gain momentum from its product offensive in the third quarter, driven by growing customer demand for new combustion-engine and battery-electric vehicles. Mercedes-Benz Group sold 491,700 cars and vans, while group-wide battery-electric vehicle (BEV) sales across Cars and Vans increased by 52%.

“Mercedes-Benz Cars achieved the highest quarterly BEV sales in the company’s history, led by the electric GLC, whose sales more than tripled compared with Q2. Outside China, car sales increased for the third consecutive quarter in 2026. Our new electric models GLC, CLA, GLB and GLA are sold out in Europe for the rest of the year, with order books extending into 2027. This demonstrates that our product launch program is in full swing.”

Mathias Geisen, Member of the Board of Management of Mercedes-Benz Group AG, Sales & Customer Experience

Mercedes-Benz Anniversary Year “140 Years of Innovation”
Since Carl Benz filed the patent for the first automobile 140 years ago and Gottlieb Daimler built his motorized carriage shortly afterwards, Mercedes‑Benz has dedicated itself to constant innovation and to creating the world’s most desirable cars for customers. This ambition has driven every innovation – from the world's first automobile in 1886 to the biggest product launch program in the company’s history that is currently underway. With its passion for performance and pioneering power, excellence and an unwavering commitment to customer service, the brand has consistently shaped the future of mobility. The result goes well beyond engineering achievement – it creates the unmistakable feeling that leads through everything Mercedes‑Benz does: Welcome home.

Mercedes-Benz is celebrating 140 years of innovation by driving three new S-Class sedans on a trans-continental journey to 140 locations worldwide. Each place highlights the brand’s technology, heritage, pioneering spirit and worldwide presence. Along the way customers, fans and colleagues will get to join in the celebrations - on an epic adventure that will run until October. Follow the “140 Years. 140 Places” drive across six continents on our “140 Years of Innovation | Mercedes-Benz Media” special and via the Mercedes-Benz Community.

About Mercedes-Benz USA
Mercedes-Benz USA (MBUSA), headquartered in Atlanta, is responsible for the distribution, marketing, and customer service for all Mercedes-Benz products in the United States. MBUSA offers drivers the most diverse lineup in the luxury segment with 18 model lines ranging from the sporty GLA SUV to the flagship S-Class and the dynamic all-electric vehicles from Mercedes-Benz. MBUSA is also responsible for Mercedes-Benz Vans in the U.S. More information on MBUSA and its products can be found at www.mbusa.com and www.mbvans.com. To learn more about all Mercedes-Benz entities in North America, visit https://group.mercedes-benz.com/northamerica/.

Accredited journalists can visit our media site at media.mbusa.com.
